topic: Curvature-coupled centripetal banking versus flat tangent-only orientation
topic_zh: 路径曲率向心压坡与纯切向平漂朝向对比
scope: Deterministic Frenet-Serret planar curvature banking φ* = atan(v²κ/g), 5-stencil finite-difference comparison and Node CPU solving. No NMPC autopilot execution or aerodynamic CFD.

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. Closed-form 1st/2nd derivative cross-product curvature versus 5-point central finite-difference stencil, not CFD or GPU rendering.

protocol.function: path derivatives (v, a) → centripetal a_c = (x'z'' - z'x'')/v → bank φ* = atan(a_c/g) → 0 lateral slip

robustness.name: Sampled figure-eight frames retain zero lateral slip under reverse visitation

good_fit: Drone, aircraft, and racing camera path orientation
Deriving natural roll angles automatically from path curvature
Eliminating flat horizontal skidding in spline-following animations
not_for: Full Navier-Stokes aerodynamic wing stall and vortex CFD
Hardware quadrotor IMU/ESC motor control under wind gusts
Ground vehicles with tire slip angles and suspension roll
